About

Incorporated in 1943,RBL Bank is a banking company engaged in providing specialized services under five business verticals namely: Corporate Banking, Commercial Banking, Branch & Business Banking, Retail Assets and Treasury & Financial Markets Operations.[1][2]

Key Points

Business Profile[1]
RBL Bank Limited is headquartered in Mumbai. It operates across retail and wholesale banking segments, with a focus on secured retail and commercial banking.

Documents

Announcements

All
  • RBL Bank Limited Informs The Exchange About Intimation Under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
    3 Sep - RBL Bank received GST show cause notice for Rs 164.14 crore demand for FY23 over bullion business ITC mismatch.
  • Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Investor Presentation
    3 Sep - RBL Bank Limited informs the exchange about Investor meet and Investor Presentation.
  • Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
    3 Sep - RBL Bank schedules investor group meetings in Mumbai from September 8-11, 2026; presentation uploaded.
  • Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting To Be Held On September 7, 2026
    2 Sep - Board meeting on September 7, 2026 to consider EMTN programme and future foreign currency debt issuance.
  • Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Scrutinizer''s Report
    2 Sep - RBL Bank’s 83rd AGM passed all 12 resolutions, including Rs 1 dividend and Rs 10,000 crore debt-raising approval.
